youtube_description:
Course Horse was selected as a National Winner of the Silicon Valley comes to the UK 2011 competition. The award was presented by Prime Minister David Cameron, Reid Hoffman (co-founder LinkedIn) and Sherry Coutu (TechCrunch Top CEO Mentor - Europe) on Wednesday 16th November 2011 at Number 10 Downing Street. This interview was aired on BBC Breakfast at 7.50am on Thursday 17th Nov 2011. 

The Course Horse app is compare the market solution focused on vocational training providing a user with the option to find a course in their local area tailored to their needs to support them to find a job in the local community. We also provide direct enrolment and accesses to funding streams. 

The team includes:

Nikhilkumar (Nik) Adhia
KC Lee
Giovanni Milandri
Fatima Sabar 
Niluka Satharasinghe
